title: Forward scan of the scratch tape
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, input-head position $p$, stream word, target word $w$, stream-head position $s$, and integer start position $j$ with $j\le |w|$, after $|w|-j+1$ steps from control state $0$ with target head at $j$, the reset machine is in control state $1$, with the target still equal to $w$ and its head at $|w|-1$.
replaced: For every input word, input position, stream, target word $w$, stream head, and start cell $j \le |w|$, running the reset machine for $|w| - j + 1$ steps from its scanning control moves the target head right across each occupied cell, turns at the right blank, and enters the erasing control at cell $|w| - 1$; the target is still unchanged.
